propositions: Execution must resolve only the selected lazy handler reference through a closed typed adapter-kind set and invoke it without re-parsing command or nested options.

Registry-derived mount/init policies, confirmation/output extraction, legacy output passthrough, and exception contracts must match pre-cutover behavior for all existing commands including no-auto-mount and conditional cases.
Only the selected handler and parser modules must be imported during dispatch; unrelated handlers and optional stacks must not be loaded.
Bridge compatibility spellings and hidden bridge-status must execute through approved adapters while purge-bridge remains unknown and unavailable.
The router must preserve original command remainder argv unchanged and the selected S2 factory must parse it exactly once with no route-level option grammar.
Rollback capability must be maintained through derived compatibility exports without changes to handler signatures, generated help, or persisted data.
